findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - sign-off blocks in an unsigned client repo with stage = "prototype".
The generated command omits --kind. src/forge/task.py:615-618 refuses fix start in that state unless a kind is supplied, so following this next step starts no repair. Both new test fixtures use the live stage (the new-client fixture omits stage, whose default is live), hiding the main prototype case. Include the required kind in the suggested command and exercise it in a prototype-stage client.
